_comment: Prospective-validation generation stage, attempt 2: a configuration chosen because it PRODUCES PARTIAL CONTAMINATION. The first attempt (dense + template_plus_projection) put all five top-k slots on adversarial passages for every attacked query, so the retrieval-side label n_poison_in_context was 5 everywhere and there was no graded label to compute a ROC against. Across all committed runs, intermediates (poison_share 0.2/0.4/0.6/0.8) occur in about 18% of rows, and the st retriever with the word-level 'template' attack at rho = 0.001 gave poison_share in {0.0, 0.4} -- a usable spread. That combination is used here. Costs nothing for keys already cached.
